evidence: On the floor she blasted the GOP law's near-$1 trillion Medicaid cuts and pledged to restore the health funding Republicans cut (Jul 2025).
Called for ICE guardrails incl. judicial warrants, a mask ban, visible ID, body cameras and letting states sue DHS (Feb 2026).
Cosponsor, American Family Act (S.1393), expanding the Child Tax Credit (Apr 2025); also cosponsored S.3596 to make it refundable from the first dollar (Mar 2026).
Cosponsor, Improving Seniors' Timely Access to Care Act of 2025 (S.1816), joining Sep 2025.
As Missouri AG he moved minutes after Dobbs to enforce the state's near-total abortion ban (Jun 2022); related action, not a vote on WHPA.
In a NatCon speech he criticized both legal and illegal immigration and said the U.S. is not a universal nation (Sep 2025); no stance on a legalization bill.
As governor pledged a total abortion ban if Roe fell (May 2022) and in 2023 cosponsored federal abortion-restriction bills; related, not a WHPA vote.
As a 2014 governor candidate he opposed raising Nebraska's minimum wage; a state-level stance, no federal statement found.
As governor vetoed LB580, which would have created an independent redistricting commission, calling it unaccountable (Apr 2016); state-level, related.
As governor vetoed bills giving DACA recipients driver's and professional licenses (2015, 2016); related state action, no stance on federal legalization found.
Sponsor, Fairness for Immigrant Families Act (S.5138, Jul 2026), creating a citizenship path for long-settled immigrants; urged balanced policy incl. border security.
Cosponsor, GRID Savings Act of 2026 (S.5199), assigning 150MW+ loads like data centers their grid interconnection costs to shield other customers (Sep 2026).
Cosponsor, DISCLOSE Act of 2026 (S.3991), expanding political-spending disclosure (Mar 2026); a narrower measure that does not ban corporate PACs or super PACs.

Cosponsor, GUARD Act (S.3062), setting federal AI chatbot safety rules with criminal and civil penalties (Jan 2026); also voted to strip the state AI-law moratorium (Jul 2025); a narrower bill than broad AI guardrails.
